summary.zh: 用 design token 与组件库统一视觉规范
summary.en: Unify UI with design tokens and a component library

description.zh: 基于 Tailwind CSS v4 建立 design token、组件库与响应式规范，用于统一多页面的视觉与交互。适合从零搭建设计系统或收敛零散样式时使用。需要项目已接入 Tailwind。
description.en: Build design tokens, a component library, and responsive rules on Tailwind CSS v4 to keep UI consistent across pages. Suited to new design systems or consolidating scattered styles; needs Tailwind in the project.
